PluginData.Author: Space; Viktor
PluginData.Tooltip: Replaces the jump drive effect with a black smoke teleport
PluginData.Description:
Jump drives now open an Elite Dangerous style gate to move the ship between two points: - Clouds appear at both the entry and exit locations. - Crew members will see the outside environment become a dark abyss. - Aborted and chained jumps are handled.
The plugin also works in multiplayer (though the smoke is a slight self-nerf for PVP). Options are highly configurable and can be adjusted in the plugin settings!
